Breaking News.text:
TRUMP WARNS U.K.: DO NOT GIVE AWAY DIEGO GARCIA

Donald Trump urged Prime Minister Keir Starmer not to enter a 100-year lease over Diego Garcia, calling it a “big mistake” that would weaken British control of the strategic Indian Ocean island.

Trump questioned the legitimacy of those claiming rights to the territory and warned that losing control could harm U.K. security. He said the U.S. may need access to Diego Garcia—and the airfield at Fairford—if tensions with Iran escalate.

While affirming strong U.S.-U.K. ties, Trump argued Britain must remain firm and avoid what he called a “tenuous” deal.

“DO NOT GIVE AWAY DIEGO GARCIA,” he said.

Breaking News.text:
COINBASE CEO: BITCOIN SLIDE IS TEMPORARY

Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong says Bitcoin’s recent drop is driven more by psychology than fundamentals.

Speaking to CNBC at the World Liberty Forum in Florida, Armstrong dismissed theories tying the decline to Fed leadership speculation or quantum computing risks. He said investors are simply locking in gains and reacting to what they think others believe.

Armstrong called the downturn likely temporary, noting Coinbase is repurchasing shares and buying more Bitcoin at lower prices.

“Crypto goes up and down,” he said, adding that Bitcoin remains the best-performing asset of the past decade and that the company is focused on the long term.
Breaking News.author: DeItaone

Breaking News.text:
GOLDMAN CEO ADMITS HE OWNS BITCOIN

After years of skepticism, Goldman Sachs CEO David Solomon says he owns a small amount of Bitcoin.

Speaking at the World Liberty Forum in Florida, Solomon described his holdings as “very, very limited” and said he’s not a Bitcoin forecaster—just an observer.

He has previously called Bitcoin volatile and speculative, saying in 2024 that he didn’t see a clear use case.

His shift reflects Wall Street’s growing engagement with crypto as the sector gains legitimacy under President Donald Trump’s administration. Goldman, once constrained by regulation, has largely kept its distance—but the tone is changing.
Breaking News.author: DeItaone
